questions.question: How should I remove the 19 redundant files (+2 companions)?

options.label: git rm (delete)
options.description: Delete them outright. Git history still preserves every version, so nothing is truly lost — cleanest tree.

options.label: Move to docs/archive/
options.description: Keep an in-tree audit trail of the resolved bug logs / findings by moving them under docs/archive/ instead of deleting.

questions.question: Three kept design docs describe unbuilt work with NO board ticket (money-flow subsystem, independence-countdown feature, login 2FA/session phases). What about those?

options.label: Keep files, no tickets
options.description: Leave the 3 design docs in place as the spec; don't create tickets. Board stays as-is.

options.label: Keep + file tickets
options.description: Keep the docs AND open board tickets for the untracked unbuilt work so the board truly reflects everything.

options.label: Delete them too
options.description: Treat them as stale and remove them with the rest. Loses the only spec for that unbuilt work (recoverable via git history).
